figures.claim: Conventional teaching places its attachment on the deep surface of the distal quadriceps tendon over a span of about 20 mm, ending at the top of the patella.
A patella that dislocates because of trochlear geometry or tubercle position is not held by a 1 mm sheet, and the anatomy says that before any trial does.
